title: Golden Ticket Tour of the AI Software Factory
abstract:
What happens when you stop asking AI to write code and start asking it to deliver software?

Join Calum Simpson, SSW’s VP of AI, for a golden-ticket tour of the AI software factory. Through real experiments, surprising successes and instructive failures, discover what agents can do, where they go off-script, and why the machinery behind the magic still matters.

See how people and agents turn ideas into working enterprise solutions, and leave with practical ways to move beyond the chat window.
